t: A build-your-own robot arm on three omni wheels that learns from your demos.
steps: Choose a build. The guide suggests the 5 V power bank version for first-timers.
Get the parts. Print the free STL files yourself, or buy the Seeed Studio LeKiwi base kit with printed parts.
Order the rest of the parts list, such as the Raspberry Pi 5, two USB cameras and two SO-101 arms.
Assemble the base and the arm with the official assembly guide.
Install Raspberry Pi OS on a microSD card and install LeRobot on the Pi and your laptop.
Set the wheel servo IDs to 7, 8 and 9 and run the calibration step in the LeRobot LeKiwi guide.
Try the teleoperation example and drive the robot with your keyboard and leader arm.
Record a short dataset and train your first policy.
meta: Wild Open. From $201. A few stores.
